AutoDNA — Project API Reference
================================

API documentation for AutoDNA: the desktop application (``app/`` — drive
loading, GPS/DEM turn and hill detection, segment fuel records, the Ridge
fuel-consumption model, and the PyQt6 UI), the IMU signal-processing and feature
code (``ai/``), the STM32 binary parser (``stm32/``), and the test suite
(``tests/``).

   :caption: Contents

   ai
   stm32
   tests
